## 网桥
xrbr0: 端口 无
xrbr1: 端口 xr1

## sysctl
net/ipv4/ip_forward=<值>
net/ipv6/conf/all/forwarding=<值>

Interface wlan1
	type AP
	ssid TestAP
	channel 6 (2437 MHz)
Station aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff (on wlan1)
	inactive time:	10 ms
	signal:  	-40 dBm
	connected time:	20 seconds
tether_offload_disabled=

private_dns_mode=

## 运行状态
guest/guest/hotspot=on 192.168.43.1/24 
guest/guest/ipv6=ok 多一行 
net.gw=on 
net.hs_if=wlan1 
net.
net.up_if=wlan0 
state=stable
